
### late arriving packets (1)  {.smaller}


* suppose we transmit 1 bit per wallclock time unit:
* wallclock time 0: A1 (1000 bit), A2 (500 bit)
* wallclock time 800: B1 (250 bit), B2 (250 bit) 
<hr class="vspace" />
* want finish virtual times: 

   * A1 (1000), A2 (1000 + 500)
   * B1 (800 + 250), B2 (800 + 250 + 250)

* … because we're on round 800 when B1, B2 received


### late arriving packets (2)  {.smaller}


* suppose we transmit 1 bit per wallclock time unit:
* wallclock time 0: A1 (1000 bit), B1 (1100 bit)
* wallclock time 800: C1 (500 bit) 
<hr class="vspace" />
* if we were going bit-by-bit we'd have transmitted 400 bits of A1 and 400 bits of B1
* so we want finish virtual times: 

   * A1 (1000), B1 (1100), C1(<em>400</em>+500=900)

* problem: we can't stop transmitting A1 to transmit C1!


### tracking round numbers  {.smaller}


* suppose packets for A, B queued at time 0--100 

   * virtual time 0--100 (full speed)

* then packets for A, B, C queued at time 100-200 

   * virtual time 100--133 (one-third speed)
   * … and last packet for A finish at time 200…

* then packets for B, C queued at time 200-400 

   * virtual time 133--183 (one-half speed)
   * … and last packet for B finishes at time 400

* then packets for C queued at time 400-500 

   * virtual time 183-283 (full speed)
